name: HeatmapChart.data
description: Column data — one entry per week (or category) with row bins inside.

name: HeatmapChart.onCellSelect
description: Select a dated bin by click/tap or Enter/Space after keyboard inspection.

name: HeatmapChart.xDomain
description: Visible time range — filters week columns that overlap the domain.

name: HeatmapChart.sizingColumnCount
description:
Week columns used for cell sizing when `xDomain` is set. Keeps bin height
stable while scrubbing (filtered columns can vary by ±1 at boundaries).

name: HeatmapChart.layout
description:
`fluid` — width drives square cells; chart height hugs the grid (GitHub-style).
`fill` — expands cells to fill the parent.

name: HeatmapChart.margin
description: Chart margins

name: HeatmapChart.binSize
description: Fixed cell size in pixels. When 0, cells are square and sized to fit the plot. Default: 0

name: HeatmapChart.gap
description: Gap between cells in pixels. Default: 2

name: HeatmapChart.colorScale
description: Override the default color scale.

name: HeatmapChart.levelColors
description: Per-level colors for the Less → More scale (5 entries).

name: HeatmapChart.levelStyles
description: Per-level fill styles (color and optional pattern). Takes precedence over `levelColors`.

name: HeatmapChart.aspectRatio
description: Optional outer aspect ratio (e.g. "2 / 1"). Omit to fill the parent.

name: HeatmapChart.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: HeatmapChart.status
description: Fetch / display status. Default: `"ready"`.

name: HeatmapChart.loadingLabel
description: Centered label while loading.

name: HeatmapChart.animationDuration
description: Enter animation duration in milliseconds. Default: 1600

name: HeatmapChart.enterTransition
description: Motion enter transition (spring or cubic-bezier tween).

name: HeatmapChart.revealSignature
description: Signature of motion URL state — triggers enter replay when it changes.

name: HeatmapChart.enterStaggerScale
description: Scales wave stagger delays (1 = default).

name: HeatmapChart.animate
description: Play enter fade-in / loading shimmer animations. Default: true

name: HeatmapChart.loadingOpacity
description: Chart opacity while loading. Default: 0.5

name: HeatmapChart.showLoadingCells
description: Show loading cell shimmer while loading. Default: true

name: HeatmapChart.loadingCellMaxOpacity
description: Max opacity loading cells animate toward (0–1). Default: 0.5

name: HeatmapChart.loadingCellRandomness
description: Share of cells that participate in loading shimmer (0–1). Default: 0.65

name: HeatmapChart.columnSeparators
description: Optional composition API.

name: HeatmapChart.weekStartDay
description:
First row of the grid — `0` = Sunday (GitHub default), `1` = Monday, etc.
Rotates column bins for display without reshaping source data.

name: HeatmapChart.children
description: Child components (HeatmapCells, HeatmapXAxis, HeatmapYAxis)

name: HeatmapCells.cornerRadius
description: Corner radius for each cell. Default: 2

name: HeatmapCells.colorScale
description: Override the default GitHub-style green color scale.

name: HeatmapCells.inactiveOpacity
description: Opacity for inactive cells while hovering. Default: 0.3

name: HeatmapCells.inactiveScale
description: Scale for inactive cells while hovering. Default: 1

name: HeatmapCells.activeScale
description: Scale for the highlighted cell while hovering. Default: 1

name: HeatmapCells.rowOpacity
description: Per-row opacity multiplier (display row index). Default: 1

name: HeatmapCells.interactive
description: Pointer hover + dimming. Default: true

name: HeatmapCells.hideGhostCells
description: Hide out-of-range bins (GitHub-style ghost cells). Default: true

name: HeatmapLegend.lessLabel
description: Side label before the swatches. Default: "Less"

name: HeatmapLegend.moreLabel
description: Side label after the swatches. Default: "More"

name: HeatmapLegend.cellSize
description: Swatch size in pixels. Default: 11

name: HeatmapLegend.gap
description: Gap between swatches. Default: 2

name: HeatmapLegend.cornerRadius
description: Corner radius for swatches. Default: 2

name: HeatmapLegend.align
description: Horizontal alignment within the legend cell. Default: "end"

name: HeatmapLegend.variant
description: Legend layout — discrete swatches or a continuous gradient bar. Default: `"swatches"`

name: HeatmapLegend.gradientSpan
description: Gradient bar width in swatch units when `variant="gradient"`. Default: 5

name: HeatmapLegend.fontSize
description: Font size in pixels for side labels.

name: HeatmapLegend.labelClassName
description: Additional class name for less/more labels.

name: HeatmapLegend.levelStyles
description: Shared level styles for cells and legend swatches.

name: HeatmapLegend.colorScale
description: Override the default color scale (used when `levelStyles` is omitted).

name: HeatmapLegend.inactiveOpacity
description: Opacity for inactive swatches while interacting. Default: 0.3

name: HeatmapLegend.inactiveScale
description: Scale for inactive swatches while interacting. Default: 1

name: HeatmapLegend.activeScale
description: Scale for the highlighted swatch while interacting. Default: 1

name: HeatmapLegend.interactive
description: Sync dimming with chart hover. Default: true when inside HeatmapInteractionProvider

name: HeatmapLegend.className
description: Optional composition API.

name: HeatmapTooltip.formatLabel
description: Custom contribution line (bottom section). Default: `N contribution(s)`.

name: HeatmapTooltip.className
description: Custom class name

name: HeatmapTooltip.panelStyle
description: Inline styles for the tooltip panel (background, blur, etc.).

name: HeatmapTooltip.backgroundColor
description:
Tooltip panel background color (CSS variable or color value).
Default: `var(--surface-floating)`.

name: HeatmapTooltip.showDelay
description:
Delay before showing the tooltip on first hover (ms).
Moving between cells updates immediately once visible.

name: HeatmapTooltip.hideDelay
description:
Grace period before hiding when the pointer leaves a cell (ms).
Helps avoid flicker when moving quickly between adjacent cells.

name: HeatmapTooltip.instant
description: When true, the tooltip appears and disappears instantly with no motion.

name: HeatmapSeparator.every
description: Optional composition API.

name: HeatmapSeparator.groupBy
description:
Group columns by fixed interval (`every`) or calendar quarter (`quarter`).
Default: `"every"`.

name: HeatmapSeparator.className
description: Additional class name for each separator group.

name: HeatmapSeparator.spacing
description: Optional composition API.

name: HeatmapSeparator.paddingX
description: Half-width of the line band in pixels (line is centered). Default: 0

name: HeatmapSeparator.paddingY
description: Inset from the bottom of the plot in pixels. Default: 0

name: HeatmapSeparator.startOffset
description: Optional composition API.

name: HeatmapSeparator.labelOffset
description:
Distance below the separator line top to place quarter labels.
`0` aligns labels with the line top. Default: 0.

name: HeatmapSeparator.showLabels
description: Draw Q1–Q4 labels at the start of each quarter group. Default: false

name: HeatmapSeparator.labelFormat
description: Format quarter group labels. Default: `Q{n}`

name: HeatmapSeparator.labelClassName
description: Additional class name for quarter labels

name: HeatmapSeparator.strokeStyle
description: Solid or dashed separator line. Default: `"solid"`

name: HeatmapSeparator.strokeDasharray
description: Dash pattern when `strokeStyle="dashed"`. Default: `"4,4"`

name: HeatmapSeparator.stroke
description: Line stroke color when `gradient` is omitted. Default: `var(--border)`

name: HeatmapSeparator.gradient
description:
Vertical stroke gradient aligned to each line's span.
Use matching `from`/`via`/`to` colors with fading opacities to soften the
top and bottom (e.g. `{ fromOpacity: 0, viaOpacity: 1, toOpacity: 0 }`).

name: HeatmapSeparator.strokeWidth
description: Line stroke width in pixels. Default: 1

name: HeatmapSeparator.strokeOpacity
description: Multiplier applied to solid strokes or gradient stop opacities. Default: 1

name: HeatmapChartLoading.data
description: Target column data used to size the skeleton grid.

name: HeatmapChartLoading.xDomain
description: Visible time range — filters week columns that overlap the domain.

name: HeatmapChartLoading.margin
description: Chart margins

name: HeatmapChartLoading.gap
description: Gap between cells in pixels. Default: 2

name: HeatmapChartLoading.cornerRadius
description: Corner radius for each cell. Default: 2

name: HeatmapChartLoading.label
description: Centered shimmer label text. Default: "Loading"

name: HeatmapChartLoading.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: HeatmapXAxis.className
description: Additional class name for labels

name: HeatmapYAxis.className
description: Additional class name for labels

name: HeatmapYAxis.tickFilter
description: Which row ticks to display. Default: `"odd"` (Mon / Wed / Fri).

name: HeatmapYAxis.labelFormat
description: Label format — `"initial"` shows the first letter only (Mon → M). Default: `"full"`.

name: HeatmapYAxis.rowOpacity
description: Optional composition API.
